answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because ripple only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, saffron is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any relic approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
